title: Incremental value of radiomics with machine learning to the existing prognostic models for predicting outcome in renal cell carcinoma
summary: Across 689 patients, the radiomics nomogram added prognostic value over existing clinical models.
ai_technology: Random forest and LASSO-Cox selected CT radiomics for a renal-cell-carcinoma survival nomogram.
organization: Department of Urology, The First Affiliated Hospital of Nanjing Medical University, Nanjing, China

evidence.tested: Across 689 patients, the radiomics nomogram added prognostic value over existing clinical models.
evidence.unknown: Training plus two validation cohorts and survival discrimination/calibration analyses; retrospective result does not establish treatment benefit.
evidence.ai_role: Random forest and LASSO-Cox selected CT radiomics for a renal-cell-carcinoma survival nomogram.
